{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert `revenue` to numeric: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Display the number of QA orders and their order IDs
len(qa_orders), qa_orders['order_id'].tolist()"}
